label: prepare_container
description: Hands position a clear glass tumbler on a table strewn with decorative beads and fairy lights, prepping the transparent vessel for a gel-look candle.

label: measure_wax
description: White wax pellets are scooped/poured into a small metal pouring pitcher; a tealight and supplies sit on the table.

label: melt_wax
description: The metal pitcher sits on a small burner; the wax melts into a clear, colourless liquid.

label: melt_wax
description: The clear molten wax is stirred in the pitcher with a wooden stick to fully liquefy it.

label: pour_wax
description: Clear molten wax is poured from the pitcher into the decorated glass; a wick is held upright on a stick laid across the rim.

label: pour_wax
description: The glass fills with transparent wax around the centred wick; embedded beads and glitter settle in the clear body.

label: reveal_result
description: A hand holds up the finished glittery transparent candle, then it is shown lit.

label: reveal_result
description: Beauty shot of the finished lit transparent candles arranged among the bead-and-light decor.
